key_insight: Crystoria links crystal structures with phonon-based dynamical stability labels at a scale of 2.65 million structures for materials AI.
engineering_relevance: The dataset can support AI models that screen candidate crystals for dynamical stability alongside thermodynamic properties.
method: Curate low-energy and metastable inorganic crystals and standardize structural identities.
evidence_signal: Crystoria contains 2,649,640 structures spanning 89 elements, 219 space groups, and 1–48 atoms per primitive cell; 1,793,353 structures (67.68%) are classified as dynamically stable.
watch_item: Dynamical stability labels alone do not establish experimental synthesizability or stability under operating conditions.
paper_title: Crystoria: A Large-Scale Crystal Dataset Linking Thermodynamic and Dynamical Stability for Materials AI
